items.title: Trek Marlin 7 Mountain Bike
items.description: 2021 Trek Marlin 7 in outstanding condition. Only ridden about 200 miles on light trail and gravel. Hydraulic disc brakes, 29" wheels, 1x10 Shimano Deore drivetrain. No scratches on the frame, tires have plenty of tread. Selling because I upgraded to a full-suspension rig. Great deal for someone looking to get into mountain biking.

shipping.notes: Bike will be partially disassembled (front wheel, handlebars, pedals removed) and packed in a bike box. Buyer pays actual shipping. Local pickup always welcome and free.

items.title: Giant Contend AR 3 Road Bike
items.description: 2020 Giant Contend AR 3 endurance road bike. Rides smooth on pavement and light gravel. Shimano Claris 2x8 drivetrain, mechanical disc brakes. Some minor cosmetic scratches on the downtube but mechanically perfect. Includes bottle cages and a saddle bag.

shipping.notes: Partial disassembly required for shipping. Buyer pays actual freight cost.

items.title: Shimano XT M8100 Rear Derailleur
items.description: Shimano Deore XT M8100 12-speed rear derailleur. Removed from bike after upgrading to electronic shifting. Less than 500 miles use. Shadow RD+ technology for smooth, quiet shifting. Compatible with 10-51T cassettes.

details.Condition: Excellent – minor cable housing wear only

shipping.notes: Ships in padded envelope or small box via USPS Priority.

items.title: Maxxis Aggressor 29x2.3 Tires – Pair
items.description: Matched pair of Maxxis Aggressor 29x2.3" EXO TR (tubeless ready) tires. About 300 miles of use, no cuts or tears, plenty of knob life left. Great all-around MTB trail tire. Selling as a pair.

shipping.notes: Ships USPS Priority or UPS ground.

items.title: KitchenAid Artisan Stand Mixer – 5 Qt
items.description: KitchenAid Artisan 5-quart stand mixer in Empire Red. Works perfectly, all original attachments included: flat beater, dough hook, wire whip, and pouring shield. Light use — mostly used for holiday baking. Retails for $450+.

details.Includes: Flat beater, dough hook, wire whip, pouring shield, bowl

shipping.notes: Ships double-boxed with original foam inserts if available. Actual shipping cost applies.

items.title: Dyson V8 Animal Cordless Vacuum
items.description: Dyson V8 Animal cordless stick vacuum. Holds a charge well (~25 minutes run time), all attachments included. Filters recently cleaned. Some light scratches on the main body but suction is strong. Comes with docking/charging station, crevice tool, brush head, and soft dusting brush.

shipping.notes: Ships UPS Ground. Fragile – packed carefully.

items.title: Patagonia Nano Puff Jacket – Men's Large
items.description: Patagonia Nano Puff insulated jacket in Black, Men's Large. Excellent warmth-to-weight ratio. No tears, broken zippers, or significant wear. Light pilling on the shell in a couple spots (shown in photos). Washed per instructions.

shipping.notes: Ships USPS Priority in a poly mailer.

items.title: Danner Mountain 600 Hiking Boots – Size 10
items.description: Danner Mountain 600 low hiking boots in Mushroom/Brown, Men's Size 10 D (medium width). Full-grain leather upper, Danner Dry waterproof membrane, Vibram outsole. About 100 miles on trail. Minor scuffs on the toe box (shown in photos), waterproofing still excellent. Sole has plenty of life.

shipping.notes: Ships in original box when possible.

items.title: IKEA BEKANT Corner Desk – White
items.description: IKEA BEKANT L-shaped corner desk in white with black legs. 63"x43" work surface. Some minor surface scratches (not visible from normal working position) but structurally solid. All hardware included. Local pickup only — will not ship. Can help disassemble.

shipping.notes: LOCAL PICKUP ONLY. Too large to ship economically. Bring a truck or large SUV — this is two large boxes.

items.title: Mid-Century Modern Walnut Bookshelf
items.description: Solid walnut-veneer mid-century style bookshelf, 5 shelves. 48" tall x 32" wide x 12" deep. Beautiful wood grain, sturdy construction. Minor wear on the bottom shelf edge. No wobble. Matches Danish modern and Scandinavian decor perfectly.

shipping.notes: Local pickup only. Can help carry to vehicle.

items.title: RIDGID 18V 3-Tool Combo Kit (R9208)
items.description: RIDGID 18V 3-piece combo kit: drill/driver, circular saw, and LED work light. Both batteries hold a charge, charger included. Drill chuck is tight, saw blade is sharp. Original carrying bag included. Lightly used for home projects.

details.Includes: Drill/Driver, 6.5" Circular Saw, LED Work Light

shipping.notes: Ships UPS Ground with batteries properly packaged per carrier requirements.

items.title: Nintendo Switch OLED + 3 Games
items.description: Nintendo Switch OLED model in white. Includes dock, HDMI cable, power adapter, Joy-Con grip, and both Joy-Con controllers (no drift issues). Games included: Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, and Pokémon Scarlet. Micro SD card (128GB) also included.

details.Includes: Dock, HDMI, power adapter, Joy-Con grip, 3 games, 128GB SD
details.Games: Zelda TotK, Mario Kart 8 DX, Pokémon Scarlet
